description: This file defines the `CheckoutModel`, a Razor Page Model handling the checkout process in an ASP.NET Core web application for the eShopOnWeb project. It manages the shopping basket, processes user checkout actions, and handles user authentication and basket state persistence via cookies.

classes.name: CheckoutModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class responsible for managing the checkout process, including basket retrieval, order creation, and handling user authentication state.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the basket view model for the checkout page.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the checkout, update basket quantities, create an order, and handle exceptions related to an empty basket.

methods.name: SetBasketModelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up the `BasketModel` based on whether the user is signed in or not.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Ensures a cookie exists for the basket, generating a new GUID if necessary, and assigns the username accordingly.
